title: GTK Gliwice clinch U19 Championship title
description: GTK Gliwice are 2024 U19 Polish champions. They overcame Enea Basket Poznan 88-75 for the trophy. Milosz Majewski (194-G/F-2007) scored 28 points, while Filip Poradzki added 18 points for the champions. Enea Poznan grabbed a 16-14 lead after ten minutes. But GTK Gliwice responded with a 27-14 rally in the second period to snatch the lead. The teams went neck and neck throughout the second half as GTK Gliwice managed to eke out a narrow victory. Rafal Szpakowski (184-G-2005) netted 23 points, while Iwo Baganc (203-SF-2006) topscored with 25 points and grabbed 12 rebounds in the loss.
